ui_bugs.issue: useAuth was imported but `user` was never destructured, causing a fresh ReferenceError 'user is not defined' at line 580 (the manager-only Forget zone check). Same class of bug as iter-4 (undeclared identifier). Testing agent applied a trivial 1-line fix (`const { user } = useAuth();`) inside the component so the rest of FIX 1 could be tested. Main agent should keep this line and add a no-undef ESLint rule + `yarn build` CI gate to catch this class of bug pre-merge.

FIX 1 part (b) NOT IMPLEMENTED — the RFM 'VIP' badge is not rendered next to the customer name in the hero section. RfmBadge is imported (line 15) but never placed in the hero JSX (lines 243-251). Backend GET /api/bi/customer/3846911099035 already returns profile.rfm_tier='vip', so adding `<RfmBadge tier={profile.rfm_tier} />` next to the H1 (line 245) is the only change required.

data-testid attributes for `nba-action`, `nba-why`, `nba-urgency` are missing from the rendered DOM (only `nba-card`, `nba-script`, `nba-use-script` have testids). The visual content renders correctly (action='Message', why text, urgency chip 'MEDIUM'), but automated assertions on those individual elements fail. Add testids to lines 283 (urgency span), 286 (action h2), 287 (why p).
